title.en: The kingdom divides; the kings of Israel and Judah
title.zh: 王國分裂；以色列和猶大的君王

en: Rehoboam goes to Shechem, where all Israel has gathered to make him king.
Jeroboam and the people ask him to lighten the heavy yoke Solomon put on them.
Rehoboam rejects the elders’ advice and follows the young men: “I will add to your yoke.”
The northern tribes reject the house of David and make Jeroboam king; only Judah stays with David’s house.
Through Shemaiah the LORD tells Rehoboam not to fight against Israel, and the army goes home.
Afraid the people will turn back to Jerusalem, Jeroboam makes two golden calves and sets them in Bethel and Dan.
He builds shrines on high places, appoints priests who are not Levites, and devises his own festival.
zh: 羅波安往示劍去，以色列眾人都聚集在那裏要立他作王。
耶羅波安和百姓求他減輕所羅門加在他們身上的重軛。
羅波安拒絕老年人的勸告，聽從少年人的話：「我要使你們的軛更重。」
北方各支派離棄大衛家，立耶羅波安作王；只有猶大仍跟從大衛家。
耶和華藉示瑪雅吩咐羅波安不可攻打以色列，軍隊就各自回家。
耶羅波安怕百姓歸向耶路撒冷，就鑄造兩頭金牛犢，安放在伯特利和但。
他在高處建造神廟，立不是利未人的作祭司，又自定節期。

about.en: Ahijah tears his new cloak into twelve pieces
about.zh: 亞希雅把新外衣撕成十二片

about.en: Chronicles tells of the division
about.zh: 歷代志記載王國分裂

about.en: Israel’s golden calf at Mount Sinai
about.zh: 以色列人在西奈山造金牛犢

about.en: A promise that the two kingdoms will become one
about.zh: 應許兩國將來合而為一

en: The kingdom divided about 930 BC. The north was called Israel (or Ephraim), later ruled from Samaria; the south was Judah, ruled from Jerusalem.
Israel had nineteen kings from several families until Assyria took it in 722 BC; Judah had twenty rulers, all of David’s line but Queen Athaliah, until 586 BC.
Shechem lay at Tell Balata, by modern Nablus. At Tel Dan in the far north, archaeologists have uncovered a large platform for worship from the time of the kings.
zh: 王國約在公元前930年分裂。北國稱為以色列（又稱以法蓮），後來建都撒馬利亞；南國稱為猶大，以耶路撒冷為京城。
以色列先後有十九個王，出自幾個不同的家族，直到公元前722年被亞述所滅；猶大有二十位君王，除亞他利雅女王外都是大衛的後裔，直到公元前586年。
示劍位於今納布盧斯旁的巴拉塔丘。考古學家在北方的但城遺址發掘出一座君王時期的大型敬拜台。

title.en: Elijah, the ravens and the widow

en: Elijah the Tishbite tells King Ahab there will be no dew or rain except at his word.
The LORD sends Elijah to hide by the Kerith Ravine, east of the Jordan.
Ravens bring him bread and meat morning and evening, and he drinks from the stream.
When the stream dries up, the LORD sends him to a widow in Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon.
She has only a handful of flour and a little oil, yet her jar and jug do not run out.
Her son falls ill and stops breathing; Elijah cries out to the LORD, and the boy’s life comes back.
The woman says, “Now I know that you are a man of God.”
zh: 提斯比人以利亞對亞哈王說，若不是他開口，必不降露，也不下雨。
耶和華打發以利亞藏在約旦河東邊的基立溪旁。
烏鴉早晚給他叼來餅和肉，他就喝溪裏的水。
溪水乾了，耶和華又打發他到屬西頓的撒勒法去找一個寡婦。
她只有一把麵粉和一點油，罈裏的麵卻不用完，瓶裏的油也不短缺。
她的兒子病得斷了氣；以利亞向耶和華呼求，孩子的生命就回來了。
婦人說：「現在我知道你是神人。」

about.en: Jesus speaks of Elijah and the widow of Zarephath
about.zh: 耶穌提到以利亞和撒勒法的寡婦

about.en: Elijah prayed, and it did not rain
about.zh: 以利亞禱告，天就不下雨

about.en: Ahab marries Jezebel and serves Baal
about.zh: 亞哈娶耶洗別，又事奉巴力

about.en: Jesus raises a widow’s son at Nain
about.zh: 耶穌使拿因城寡婦的兒子復活

en: Ahab ruled Israel from Samaria about 874–853 BC. An Assyrian inscription names him among the kings who fought Shalmaneser III at Qarqar in 853 BC.
Baal was worshipped as the Canaanite god of storm and rain. Jezebel, daughter of the king of the Sidonians, promoted his worship in Israel (1 Kings 16:31).
Zarephath was a coastal town between Tyre and Sidon; its site is by Sarafand in Lebanon.
zh: 亞哈約在公元前874至853年在撒馬利亞作以色列王。亞述的碑文記載，他是公元前853年在卡爾卡爾與撒縵以色三世交戰的諸王之一。
巴力被敬拜為迦南人掌管風暴和雨水的神。西頓王的女兒耶洗別在以色列推行巴力崇拜（列王紀上16章31節）。
撒勒法是推羅和西頓之間的一座海邊城鎮，遺址在今黎巴嫩的薩拉凡德附近。

en: In the third year of drought, Elijah meets Ahab, who calls him “troubler of Israel.”
Elijah gathers all Israel and the 450 prophets of Baal at Mount Carmel.
“How long will you go limping between two opinions? If the LORD is God, follow him.”
The prophets of Baal call on Baal from morning until evening, but no one answers.
Elijah repairs the LORD’s altar with twelve stones and has water poured on the sacrifice three times.
Elijah prays, the fire of the LORD falls, and the people cry, “The LORD, he is God!”
On top of Carmel a cloud as small as a man’s hand rises from the sea, and heavy rain falls.
zh: 旱災的第三年，以利亞去見亞哈；亞哈稱他為「使以色列遭難的人」。
以利亞把以色列眾人和四百五十個巴力的先知召集到迦密山。
「你們在兩者之間搖擺不定，要到幾時呢？如果耶和華是神，就跟從他。」
巴力的先知從早到晚求告巴力，卻沒有回應。
以利亞用十二塊石頭修築耶和華的壇，叫人三次把水倒在祭物上。
以利亞禱告，耶和華的火降下來，眾民就喊着說：「耶和華是神！」
在迦密山頂，有一小片雲像人的手掌那麼大，從海上升起，接着就下了大雨。

about.en: Elijah flees from Jezebel to Mount Horeb
about.zh: 以利亞逃避耶洗別，到了何烈山

about.en: Paul recalls Elijah and the seven thousand
about.zh: 保羅提到以利亞和七千人

about.en: Fire from the LORD consumes the first offerings
about.zh: 耶和華的火燒盡最初的祭物

en: Mount Carmel is a ridge running southeast from the coast at Haifa, Israel. A site on its southeast end, El-Muhraqa (“the place of burning”), is traditionally the place of this contest.
The Kishon River flows along the foot of Carmel into the bay of Haifa.
A seah was a dry measure; scholars’ estimates of its size range from about 7 to 13 litres.
zh: 迦密山是一道山嶺，從以色列海法的海邊向東南延伸。山嶺東南端的穆赫拉卡（意思是「焚燒之地」）相傳就是這次較量的地點。
基順河沿着迦密山腳流入海法灣。
細亞是量乾貨的單位；學者估計它的容量約在7至13公升之間。

title.en: Elijah and the chariot of fire

en: As the LORD is about to take Elijah up, Elisha refuses to leave him: “I will not leave you.”
They travel from Gilgal to Bethel, then to Jericho, then to the Jordan.
Elijah strikes the Jordan with his rolled-up cloak, the water divides, and they cross on dry ground.
Elisha asks for a double share of Elijah’s spirit.
A chariot of fire and horses of fire separate them, and Elijah goes up to heaven in a whirlwind.
Elisha picks up Elijah’s cloak and strikes the water, and it divides for him too.
The prophets from Jericho say, “The spirit of Elijah rests on Elisha.”
zh: 耶和華要接以利亞上去的時候，以利沙不肯離開他，說：「我必不離開你。」
他們從吉甲到伯特利，又到耶利哥，再到約旦河。
以利亞把外衣捲起來擊打約旦河，水就分開，二人走乾地過去。
以利沙求以利亞的靈加倍歸給他。
忽然有火的戰車和火的馬把二人隔開，以利亞乘旋風升天去了。
以利沙拾起以利亞的外衣擊打河水，水也為他分開。
耶利哥的先知們說：「以利亞的靈停在以利沙身上了。」

about.en: Elijah calls Elisha from his plowing
about.zh: 以利亞呼召正在耕地的以利沙

about.en: God will send Elijah before the day of the LORD
about.zh: 耶和華的日子以前，神要差以利亞來

about.en: Moses and Elijah with Jesus on the mountain
about.zh: 摩西和以利亞在山上與耶穌同在

about.en: John comes in the spirit and power of Elijah
about.zh: 約翰帶着以利亞的靈和能力而來

en: Elijah and Elisha were prophets in the northern kingdom in the 800s BC, under Ahab and the kings after him.
Gilgal and Jericho were where Israel first camped and conquered after crossing the Jordan under Joshua (Joshua 4–6). Jericho lies about 250 m below sea level.
Under Israel’s law, the firstborn son received a double share of his father’s inheritance (Deuteronomy 21:17).
zh: 以利亞和以利沙是公元前九世紀北國的先知，活躍於亞哈和他以後的諸王年間。
吉甲和耶利哥是以色列人在約書亞率領下過約旦河後最先安營、攻取的地方（約書亞記4至6章）。耶利哥低於海平面約250米。
按以色列的律法，長子可以得父親產業的雙份（申命記21章17節）。

title.en: Elisha: the bears and the floating axe head
title.zh: 以利沙：母熊和浮起的斧頭

en: Elisha heals the bad water of Jericho by throwing salt into its spring.
On the road to Bethel, youths come out of the town and jeer at him: “Go on up, baldhead!”
Elisha curses them in the name of the LORD, and two female bears maul forty-two of them.
The company of prophets need a bigger place, so Elisha goes with them to the Jordan to cut beams.
An iron axe head falls into the water, and the man cries out, “It was borrowed!”
Elisha throws a stick in where it fell and makes the iron float, and the man picks it up.
zh: 以利沙把鹽撒在耶利哥的水源裏，治好了那裏的壞水。
在往伯特利的路上，一群孩子從城裏出來嘲笑他：「禿頭的，上去吧！」
以利沙奉耶和華的名詛咒他們，就有兩隻母熊出來，撕裂了其中四十二個孩子。
先知們嫌住處太窄，以利沙就與他們同往約旦河去砍木頭。
有一個鐵斧頭掉進水裏，那人喊着說：「這斧頭是借來的！」
以利沙砍了一根木棍丟在斧頭掉下的地方，鐵斧頭就浮上來，那人把它拿了起來。

about.en: Elisha and the widow’s jar of oil
about.zh: 以利沙和寡婦的油

about.en: Elisha makes a poisoned stew safe to eat
about.zh: 以利沙使有毒的湯可以吃

about.en: A dead man touches Elisha’s bones and lives
about.zh: 死人碰到以利沙的骸骨就復活

en: A spring at Jericho, Ein es-Sultan, is traditionally known as Elisha’s Spring.
Bethel, where Jeroboam had set up a golden calf (1 Kings 12:29), lay about 17 km north of Jerusalem; it is usually identified with the village of Beitin.
The Syrian brown bear lived in the land in Bible times; it died out there in the twentieth century.
Iron tools were costly, and under the law a borrower had to make good anything borrowed that was lost or harmed (Exodus 22:13).
zh: 耶利哥的蘇丹泉，相傳就是「以利沙泉」。
伯特利是耶羅波安安放金牛犢的地方（列王紀上12章29節），在耶路撒冷以北約17公里，一般認為就是今天的貝廷村。
聖經時代，敘利亞棕熊生活在這地，到了二十世紀才在當地絕跡。
鐵器很昂貴；按律法，借來的東西若有損失，借的人必須賠償（出埃及記22章13節）。

en: Naaman, commander of the army of Aram, is a mighty warrior, but he has a skin disease.
A young girl taken captive from Israel tells his wife about the prophet in Samaria.
The king of Israel tears his clothes at the letter, but Elisha says, “Let him come to me.”
Elisha sends word: “Go and wash seven times in the Jordan.” Naaman goes away angry.
His servants persuade him; he dips seven times, and his flesh becomes like a young boy’s.
Naaman says, “Now I know that there is no God in all the earth except in Israel.”
Elisha’s servant Gehazi secretly takes silver from Naaman and is struck with the skin disease.
zh: 亞蘭王的元帥乃縵是英勇的戰士，卻患了嚴重的皮膚病。
一個從以色列擄來的小女孩告訴乃縵的妻子，撒馬利亞有一位先知。
以色列王讀了國書就撕裂衣服，以利沙卻說：「讓他到我這裏來。」
以利沙派人說：「去，在約旦河裏洗七次。」乃縵卻發怒走了。
他的臣僕勸他，他就在約旦河裏浸了七次，皮肉復原，好像小孩子的一樣。
乃縵說：「現在我知道，除了以色列以外，全地都沒有神。」
以利沙的僕人基哈西私下向乃縵拿了銀子，就患上了那皮膚病。

about.en: Jesus speaks of Naaman the Syrian
about.zh: 耶穌提到敘利亞人乃縵

about.en: The law for cleansing from a skin disease
about.zh: 律法中潔淨皮膚病的條例

about.en: Ten men healed; one, a Samaritan, returns to give thanks
about.zh: 十人得潔淨，一個撒馬利亞人回來感謝

en: Aram was the kingdom of the Arameans, centred on Damascus in today’s Syria; it often fought with Israel in the 800s BC.
The Amana (or Abana) is usually identified with the Barada River, which flows through Damascus; the Pharpar probably with the Awaj, south of the city.
The Hebrew word for Naaman’s disease covers many skin conditions, not only leprosy as known today.
A talent was about 30 kg (66 lb); Naaman brought ten talents of silver.
zh: 亞蘭是亞蘭人的王國，以今敘利亞的大馬色為中心，在公元前九世紀經常與以色列交戰。
亞瑪拿河一般認為就是今天流經大馬色的拜拉達河；法珥法河大概是城南的阿瓦吉河。
希伯來文中乃縵所患的病包括多種皮膚病，不只是今天所說的痲瘋病。
一他連得約重30公斤；乃縵帶了十他連得銀子。

en: The LORD tells Jonah to go to Nineveh and cry out against it, for its evil has come up before him.
Jonah runs the other way: he goes down to Joppa and boards a ship for Tarshish.
The LORD hurls a great storm on the sea; the sailors cry out to their gods while Jonah sleeps.
The lot falls on Jonah: “I fear the LORD, the God of heaven, who made the sea and the dry land.”
The sailors hurl him into the sea, and the sea stops raging.
The LORD appoints a great fish to swallow Jonah, and he is inside it three days and three nights.
Jonah prays from the fish, “Salvation belongs to the LORD!” and the fish vomits him onto dry land.
zh: 耶和華吩咐約拿往尼尼微去，向那城呼喊，因為他們的罪惡已經達到他面前。
約拿卻往反方向逃跑：他下到約帕，上了往他施去的船。
耶和華使海上起了大風暴；水手各自呼求自己的神，約拿卻在睡覺。
掣籤掣出約拿，他說：「我敬畏耶和華天上的神，就是創造海洋和陸地的那位。」
水手把他拋進海裏，海就平靜了。
耶和華安排一條大魚吞下約拿，他在魚腹中三日三夜。
約拿在魚腹中禱告：「救恩屬於耶和華！」大魚就把他吐在陸地上。

about.en: Jonah son of Amittai in the days of Jeroboam II
about.zh: 耶羅波安二世年間的亞米太的兒子約拿

about.en: Jesus speaks of the sign of Jonah
about.zh: 耶穌談到約拿的神蹟

about.en: There is nowhere to flee from God’s presence
about.zh: 無處可以逃避神的同在

about.en: Jesus calms a storm on the sea
about.zh: 耶穌平靜海上的風浪

en: Jonah son of Amittai prophesied in the days of Jeroboam II of Israel, who reigned about 786–746 BC (2 Kings 14:25).
Joppa is modern Jaffa, the old port of Tel Aviv. Tarshish lay far to the west; many identify it with Tartessus in southern Spain.
Nineveh, on the Tigris River, was a great city of the Assyrian Empire; its ruins lie by Mosul in Iraq.
In this site’s Bible, the great fish is Jonah 2:1, following the Hebrew numbering; English Bibles number it 1:17.
zh: 亞米太的兒子約拿在以色列王耶羅波安二世年間說預言；耶羅波安二世約在公元前786至746年在位（列王紀下14章25節）。
約帕就是今天的雅法，是特拉維夫的古港。他施遠在西方，許多人認為就是西班牙南部的塔特蘇斯。
尼尼微位於底格里斯河畔，是亞述帝國的大城，遺址在今伊拉克的摩蘇爾附近。
本站聖經依照希伯來文的節數，大魚一節是約拿書2章1節；英文聖經作1章17節。

en: The word of the LORD comes to Jonah a second time, and this time he goes to Nineveh.
He proclaims, “Forty days more, and Nineveh will be overthrown!”
The people believe God; from the greatest to the least they fast and put on sackcloth.
The king sits in ashes and orders everyone to call on God and turn from evil and violence.
God sees that they turn from their evil way and relents from the disaster.
Jonah is angry: he knew God is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in faithful love.
God appoints a plant, a worm and a hot wind, then asks: should I not be concerned about Nineveh?
zh: 耶和華的話第二次臨到約拿，這次他往尼尼微去了。
他宣告說：「再過四十天，尼尼微就要傾覆了！」
尼尼微人信了神；從最大的到最小的都禁食，穿上麻衣。
王坐在灰中，下令眾人呼求神，離開惡行和強暴。
神看見他們離開惡道，就改變心意，不降那災禍。
約拿發怒：他早知道神是有恩典、有憐憫的神，不輕易發怒，大有慈愛。
神安排了一棵蓖麻、一條蟲和炎熱的東風，然後問他：我豈能不愛惜尼尼微呢？

about.en: Nineveh repented at Jonah’s preaching
about.zh: 尼尼微人因約拿的宣講悔改

about.en: The LORD proclaims his name: gracious and compassionate
about.zh: 耶和華宣告他的名：有憐憫、有恩典

about.en: God relents when a nation turns from evil
about.zh: 邦國若離開惡行，神就改變心意

about.en: Nahum’s later message against Nineveh
about.zh: 那鴻後來論尼尼微的默示

en: Under Sennacherib (about 705–681 BC), Nineveh became Assyria’s capital, with walls about 12 km (7.5 miles) around.
Nineveh fell to the Babylonians and the Medes in 612 BC.
The mound of Nebi Yunus (“the prophet Jonah”) at Nineveh traditionally held Jonah’s tomb; its shrine was blown up by Islamic State in 2014.
Sackcloth was coarse cloth, often of goat hair, worn as a sign of mourning.
zh: 在西拿基立年間（約公元前705至681年），尼尼微成為亞述的京城，城牆周長約12公里。
尼尼微在公元前612年被巴比倫人和米底亞人攻陷。
尼尼微的「先知約拿丘」相傳有約拿的墳墓；那裏的聖祠在2014年被伊斯蘭國炸毀。
麻衣是粗布，常用山羊毛織成，是人哀慟時所穿的。

title.en: Hosea: God's promise to restore Israel
title.zh: 何西阿：神應許復興以色列

en: The LORD tells Hosea to marry a wife of prostitution, for the land has turned from the LORD; he marries Gomer.
Their children are named Jezreel, Lo-ruhamah (“no compassion”) and Lo-ammi (“not my people”).
Yet those called “not my people” will be called “children of the living God.”
The LORD will lead Israel into the wilderness, speak tenderly to her, and betroth her to himself forever.
Hosea is told to love an adulterous woman again, as the LORD loves Israel though they turn to other gods.
“Return, Israel, to the LORD your God.”
The LORD says, “I will heal their unfaithfulness; I will love them freely.”
zh: 耶和華吩咐何西阿娶一個淫亂的妻子，因為這地背離了耶和華；他就娶了歌篾。
他們的兒女名叫耶斯列、羅‧路哈瑪（意思是「不蒙憐憫」）和羅‧阿米（意思是「不是我的子民」）。
然而，那些被稱為「不是我的子民」的，將被稱為「永活神的兒女」。
耶和華要領以色列到曠野，對她說安慰的話，永遠聘她歸自己。
耶和華吩咐何西阿再去愛一個犯姦淫的婦人，就像耶和華愛以色列人，雖然他們轉向別的神。
「以色列啊，你要歸向耶和華你的神。」
耶和華說：「我要醫治他們的背叛，甘心愛他們。」

about.en: Paul quotes Hosea: “not my people” become God’s people
about.zh: 保羅引用何西阿論「不是我的子民」

about.en: Once not a people, now God’s people
about.zh: 從前不是子民，現在是神的子民

about.en: “When Israel was a child, I loved him”
about.zh: 以色列年幼的時候，神就愛他

about.en: Matthew quotes “Out of Egypt I called my son”
about.zh: 馬太引用「我從埃及召出我的兒子」

en: Hosea prophesied in the northern kingdom in the 700s BC, in its last decades before Assyria took Samaria in 722 BC.
Jezreel was the valley and royal city where King Jehu had shed much blood (2 Kings 9–10); the name of Hosea’s son recalls it.
Hosea often calls the northern kingdom “Ephraim,” after its largest tribe.
A shekel weighed roughly 11.5 g, so fifteen shekels was about 170 g of silver.
zh: 何西阿在公元前八世紀於北國說預言，正是亞述在公元前722年攻取撒馬利亞之前的最後幾十年。
耶斯列是平原和王城的名字，耶戶王曾在那裏大行殺戮（列王紀下9至10章）；何西阿兒子的名字就是指這事。
何西阿常用最大的支派「以法蓮」來稱呼北國。
一舍客勒約重11.5克，十五舍客勒約是170克銀子。

en: In the year King Uzziah dies, Isaiah sees the Lord on a high throne, the hem of his robe filling the temple.
Seraphim call, “Holy, holy, holy is the LORD of Armies! The whole earth is full of his glory.”
Isaiah cries, “Woe is me! I am a man of unclean lips.”
A seraph touches his mouth with a glowing coal from the altar, and his guilt is taken away.
The Lord asks, “Whom shall I send?” Isaiah answers, “Here I am. Send me!”
He is sent to a people who will hear but not understand, until the land is left desolate.
Yet a stump will remain: “The holy seed is its stump.”
zh: 烏西雅王去世那年，以賽亞看見主坐在高高的寶座上，他衣袍的下襬充滿聖殿。
撒拉弗呼喊說：「聖哉！聖哉！聖哉！萬軍之耶和華！他的榮耀充滿全地！」
以賽亞喊着說：「我有禍了！我是嘴唇不潔的人。」
一個撒拉弗用壇上燒紅的炭沾他的口，他的罪孽就除掉了。
主問：「我可以差遣誰呢？」以賽亞回答：「我在這裏，請差遣我！」
他被差到一群聽而不明白的百姓那裏，直到地土荒涼。
然而必留下樹墩：「這聖潔的種子就是樹墩。」

about.en: Living creatures cry, “Holy, holy, holy”
about.zh: 四活物呼喊「聖哉！聖哉！聖哉！」

about.en: John: Isaiah saw Jesus’ glory
about.zh: 約翰說以賽亞看見了耶穌的榮耀

about.en: Jesus quotes Isaiah on hearing without understanding
about.zh: 耶穌引用以賽亞論聽而不明白

en: King Uzziah of Judah died about 740 BC, after a long reign (2 Chronicles 26).
Isaiah son of Amoz prophesied in Jerusalem under Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah (Isaiah 1:1), for about forty years.
The Great Isaiah Scroll, found among the Dead Sea Scrolls in 1947, holds all 66 chapters; it was copied in the second century BC.
The Hebrew word seraphim is related to a verb meaning “to burn.”
zh: 猶大王烏西雅在位多年，約在公元前740年去世（歷代志下26章）。
亞摩斯的兒子以賽亞在烏西雅、約坦、亞哈斯和希西家年間於耶路撒冷說預言（以賽亞書1章1節），約有四十年。
1947年發現的死海古卷中，有一卷完整的以賽亞書，共66章，抄寫於公元前二世紀。
希伯來文「撒拉弗」與一個意思是「焚燒」的動詞有關。

en: Aram and Israel march against Jerusalem, and the hearts of King Ahaz and his people shake.
Isaiah tells Ahaz, “Do not be afraid”; their plan will not stand.
Ahaz refuses to ask for a sign, saying he will not put the LORD to the test.
The Lord himself gives a sign: the young woman will give birth to a son and call him Immanuel.
Galilee of the nations will see glory: “The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light.”
“A child has been born to us”: Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
He will reign on David’s throne with justice and righteousness, and his peace will have no end.
zh: 亞蘭和以色列上來攻打耶路撒冷，亞哈斯王和百姓的心都震動。
以賽亞對亞哈斯說：「不要怕」；他們的計謀必不能成立。
亞哈斯不肯求兆頭，說他不試探耶和華。
主自己要給一個兆頭：那少女要生一個兒子，給他起名叫以馬內利。
外邦人的加利利必得榮耀：「在黑暗中行走的百姓看見了大光。」
「有一個孩子為我們而生」：奇妙的策士、大能的神、永恆的父、和平的君。
他要坐在大衛的寶座上，以公平和公義治理，他的平安沒有窮盡。

about.en: Matthew: the birth of Jesus fulfils the Immanuel sign
about.zh: 馬太說耶穌降生應驗了以馬內利的兆頭

about.en: Jesus begins his work in Galilee: a great light
about.zh: 耶穌在加利利開始工作，應驗大光

about.en: Gabriel: Jesus will reign on David’s throne forever
about.zh: 加百列說耶穌要坐大衛的寶座

about.en: Ahaz turns to Assyria for help
about.zh: 亞哈斯向亞述求救

en: About 735 BC, Rezin of Aram and Pekah of Israel attacked Judah; many scholars think they wanted to force it into a league against Assyria.
Tiglath-pileser III of Assyria took Damascus in 732 BC and annexed Galilee, the land of Zebulun and Naphtali (2 Kings 15:29).
The Hebrew word ‘almah means “young woman”; the Greek translation made before Christ rendered it “virgin,” the word Matthew quotes.
This site follows the Hebrew numbering: English Isaiah 9:1 is 8:23 here, and 9:2–7 is 9:1–6.
zh: 約在公元前735年，亞蘭王利汛和以色列王比加攻打猶大；許多學者認為，他們是要逼猶大加入反亞述的聯盟。
亞述王提革拉‧毗列色三世在公元前732年攻取大馬色，並吞併了加利利，就是西布倫地和拿弗他利地（列王紀下15章29節）。
希伯來文的這個詞意思是「少女」；主前譯成的希臘文舊約把它譯作「童女」，馬太引用的就是這個詞。
本站依照希伯來文節數：英文以賽亞書9章1節在這裏是8章23節，9章2至7節是9章1至6節。

en: “My servant will act wisely; he will be raised and lifted up and greatly exalted.”
Many are appalled at him; his appearance is disfigured beyond that of any man.
He grows up like a root out of dry ground; he is despised and rejected by others.
“He was pierced for our rebellious acts… and by his wounds we are healed.”
“We all, like sheep, have gone astray,” and the LORD lays on him the guilt of us all.
Like a lamb led to the slaughter he does not open his mouth; he is cut off and his grave made with the wicked.
After his anguish he will see and be satisfied; he bears the sin of many and intercedes for the rebels.
zh: 「我的僕人必行事有智慧，必被高舉上升，大大受尊崇。」
許多人因他驚駭；他的面貌比任何人都憔悴。
他像根出於乾地；他被人藐視，被人厭棄。
「他卻因我們的過犯被刺傷……因他受的鞭傷，我們得了醫治。」
「我們都像羊一樣走迷了路」，耶和華卻使我們眾人的罪孽都落在他身上。
他像羊羔被牽去宰殺，卻不開口；他被剪除，人使他與惡人同埋。
他受了勞苦之後，必看見而心滿意足；他擔當多人的罪，又為罪人代求。

about.en: Philip explains this passage to an Ethiopian official
about.zh: 腓利向埃提阿伯大臣講解這段經文

about.en: Peter: by his wounds you have been healed
about.zh: 彼得說：因他受的鞭傷，你們得了醫治

about.en: Jesus says this passage must be fulfilled in him
about.zh: 耶穌說這段經文必應驗在他身上

about.en: Matthew quotes Isaiah 53 of Jesus’ healings
about.zh: 馬太引用以賽亞書53章論耶穌治病

en: Scholars call Isaiah 42, 49, 50 and 52–53 the “Servant Songs”; this is the fourth and longest.
The Great Isaiah Scroll from Qumran contains this passage, copied more than a century before Jesus was born.
Lambs were offered at the temple every morning and evening (Exodus 29:38–39), and a lamb was eaten at each Passover.
zh: 學者把以賽亞書42、49、50和52至53章稱為「僕人之歌」；這是第四首，也是最長的一首。
在昆蘭發現的以賽亞書古卷載有這段經文，抄寫的時間比耶穌降生早一百多年。
聖殿每天早晚都獻上羊羔（出埃及記29章38至39節）；每年逾越節，各家也要吃羊羔。
